translations.literal: Tan said: "Nanzhong was one who upheld rectitude and did not consort with the powerful and favored."
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "Nanzhong was a man who upheld rectitude and kept clear of the powerful and favored."

sentences.zh: 尋罷為右庶子，時人歸咎於均。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was removed and made Right Subvisor; contemporaries blamed Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Tan was demoted to Right Subvisor. Contemporaries blamed Jun.

sentences.zh: 旬月，出為宣歙池觀察使。

translations.literal: Within ten days he was sent out as Xuancheng-She-Chi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month he was sent out as observation commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi.

sentences.zh: 三年，入為刑部侍郎、鹽鐵轉運使，改戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: In the third year he entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner, then changed to Vice Minister of Revenue and overseer of the Revenue Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and Salt and Iron transport commissioner, then became Vice Minister of Revenue overseeing the Revenue Office.

sentences.zh: 元和八年，西受降城為河徙浸毀，宰相李吉甫請移兵於天德故城。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yuanhe, Western Shouxiang City was damaged by a shifting river; Chancellor Li Jifu requested moving the garrison to the old Tiede City.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 8 Western Shouxiang City was damaged when the river shifted. Chancellor Li Jifu proposed moving the garrison to old Tiede City.

sentences.zh: 坦與李絳葉議，以為：「西城張仁願所築，制匈奴上策。

translations.literal: Tan and Li Jiang jointly deliberated and considered: "The western city built by Zhang Renyuan is the supreme strategy for controlling the northern nomads.
translations.idiomatic: Tan and Li Jiang jointly argued: "The western city Zhang Renyuan built is the best strategy for holding the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 城當磧口，居虜要沖，美水豐草，邊防所利。

translations.literal: The city sits at the desert pass, occupies the enemy's vital crossing, has fine water and lush grass, and is advantageous for border defense.
translations.idiomatic: It sits at the desert pass on the enemy's vital route, with fine water and lush grass—an ideal border fortress.

sentences.zh: 今河流之決，不過退就二三里，奈何舍萬代安永之策，徇一時省費之謀？

translations.literal: Now the river's breach requires retreating only two or three li—how can one abandon a plan secure for ten thousand generations and follow a scheme to save costs for a moment?
translations.idiomatic: The river breach requires retreating only two or three li. Why abandon a plan secure for ten thousand generations for a moment's savings?

sentences.zh: 況天德故城僻處確瘠，其北枕山，與河絕遠，烽候警備，不相統接。

translations.literal: Moreover the old Tiede City lies remote in stony barrenness; to its north mountains press close, it is utterly far from the river, and beacon posts and watch stations do not connect in unified defense.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover old Tiede City lies remote on stony barren ground. Mountains press close to the north, it is far from the river, and its beacon posts do not connect with the rest of the border defense.

sentences.zh: 虜之唐突，勢無由知，是無故而蹙國二百里，非所利也。」

translations.literal: When the barbarians raid, there is no way to know—this would without cause shrink the realm by two hundred li; it is not advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: Nomad raids would go undetected. This would shrink the border two hundred li for no good reason.

sentences.zh: 及城使周懷義奏利害，與坦議同。

translations.literal: When fort commissioner Zhou Huaiyi submitted on advantages and disadvantages, his view agreed with Tan's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Fort commissioner Zhou Huaiyi submitted his analysis, which agreed with Tan's view.

sentences.zh: 事竟不行。

translations.literal: The plan ultimately was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 未幾，出為劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as military commissioner of eastern Sichuan in Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as military commissioner of eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 在鎮累年，後請收閏月軍吏糧料，以助軍行營，人多非之。

translations.literal: He remained at his command many years; later he requested collection of intercalary-month grain rations for army clerks to aid field camps, and many criticized him.
translations.idiomatic: He held his command many years. Later he requested collection of intercalary-month grain rations for army clerks to support field camps, and many criticized him.

sentences.zh: 貞元十二年九月卒，年六十九，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year of Zhenyuan he died at age sixty-nine and was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth month of Zhenyuan 12 at sixty-nine and was posthumously made Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: =史臣曰=史臣曰：古之諍臣，有死於言者。

translations.literal: The historian says: Among remonstrating ministers of old, some died for their words.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Among remonstrating ministers of old, some died for their words.

sentences.zh: 其次，引裾折檻，不改其操，亦難矣哉！

translations.literal: Next to them, those who seized the robe and broke the balustrade without changing their principles—how difficult that also was!
translations.idiomatic: Next came those who seized the emperor's robe and broke the balustrade without changing their principles—equally hard!

sentences.zh: 袁高之執盧杞，存誠之戮鑒虛，有古人之遺風焉！

translations.literal: Yuan Gao's holding Lu Qi, Cuncheng's executing Jianxu—there is the lingering style of the ancients!
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Gao's stand against Lu Qi and Cuncheng's execution of Jianxu carry the spirit of the ancients!

sentences.zh: 平仲觸鱗之氣，糾其謬歟？

translations.literal: Pingzhong's spirit of touching the dragon's scales—was it to correct their error?
translations.idiomatic: Did Pingzhong's bold remonstrance aim to correct their errors?

sentences.zh: 文洽奪章，以攄府憤；

translations.literal: Wenqia seized the memorial to vent the army headquarters' resentment;
translations.idiomatic: Wenqia seized the memorial to vent the army's rage;

sentences.zh: 永夷絕食，不飲盜泉，節義之士也。

translations.literal: Yongyi fasted to death and would not drink from Robber Spring—a man of integrity and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyi fasted to death rather than drink from Robber Spring. He was a man of integrity.

sentences.zh: 南仲非葬之言，盧坦西城之議，量之深也。

translations.literal: Nanzhong's words against the improper burial and Tan's argument for the western fort show deep measure.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhong's remonstrance against the improper burial and Tan's argument for the western fort show deep judgment.

sentences.zh: 如數子，道為時無君子，乃是厚誣。

translations.literal: For men like these to say the age had no gentlemen is gross slander.
translations.idiomatic: To say that an age with men like these had no gentlemen is gross slander.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：靈草指佞，諫臣匡失。

translations.literal: Eulogy: Spirit grass points at flatterers; remonstrating ministers correct errors.
translations.idiomatic: Eulogy: Spirit grass points at flatterers; remonstrating ministers correct the court's errors.

sentences.zh: 惟袁與薛，人中屈軼。

translations.literal: Only Yuan and Xue among men are Qu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Among men, only Yuan and Xue are Qu Yi.

sentences.zh: 寬夫雀躍，廷老鴻軒。

translations.literal: Kuanfu leaps like a sparrow; Tinglao soars like a wild goose.
translations.idiomatic: Kuanfu capers like a sparrow; Tinglao struts like a wild goose.

sentences.zh: 姚、盧啟奏，君子之言。

translations.literal: Yao and Lu opened memorials—the words of gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: The memorials of Yao and Lu are the words of gentlemen.
